text.aria-label: Subtitle text '3 wind farms (W1 to W3), 53 Tuesday runs, July 2025 to June 2026. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling the 12 months. Orange: fitted to the wind that the farms' own power implies. Blue: fitted to ERA5 (control). Dashed line: all of the 18.7-point gap between the raw ensemble (34.1% of kept rows below the median) and the ERA5 oracle (52.8%) closed. Larger is better.'
